official_documentation.purpose: NeoForge 1.21.1 mod metadata and dependency declaration reference
Current Maven VersionRange API reference; not the runtime oracle
Fabric metadata reference used only to identify inactive Fabric branches

verified_conclusions.conclusion: FML delegates declared version range parsing to Maven VersionRange.createFromVersionSpec. Evaluation must use the frozen Maven Artifact 3.8.5 runtime.
The NeoForge reader discovers META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml. Fabric metadata must remain a separate, inactive branch unless runtime behavior proves otherwise.
A dependency table is attached only to its declared owning mod ID; an unknown owner must be reported rather than silently repaired.

FML filters by physical side. Required missing or wrong-range dependencies fail; absent optional dependencies pass; installed optional dependencies with a wrong version fail; matching incompatible dependencies fail; matching discouraged dependencies warn.
For the 1.21.1 target, direct Minecraft and NeoForge checks may fall back to Minecraft 1.21 and NeoForge 21.0.166 coordinates according to the exact support matrix.
The built-in language provider obtains its version from the FML implementation version; the frozen artifact reports 4.0.
Jar-in-Jar handling negotiates and selects dependency versions; embedded archives cannot be treated only as a flat inventory.

limitations: This receipt establishes the exact loader semantics to implement; it does not evaluate any candidate or prove runtime compatibility.
The current Maven documentation URL describes 3.9.16. Frozen behavior is determined by the hashed Maven Artifact 3.8.5 runtime and the committed Java probe.
Source content is identified by immutable commit and per-file SHA-256; source copies are not redistributed in this repository.
Focused dedicated-server runtime confirmation remains required before any candidate receives a retained disposition.
